annotations.title: Add an image to a Pro draft

description: Store an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG) in a Pro draft and get its src for an image layer ({"op":"set","layer":"hero","props":{"src":"<src>"}}). Send small images as data (base64 or a data URL, up to 3 MB); for a file on disk, leave data out and the answer is the curl command that uploads it.

contentType.description: Its type, when data is plain base64.

data.description: The image as base64 or a data URL.

editToken.description: The editToken the draft came with.

file.description: Without data: the file's path, to write it into the curl command.

name: upload_pro_image
title: Add an image to a Pro draft
